quality_guards: The required controls depend on the actual atmosphere, contents, access, task and potential inflows in the specific space.
Confined-space guidance is task- and site-specific safety context and is not an exact parcel-level probability.
No type of ground can be assumed to remain unsupported in every condition; water, loading and disturbance can materially change stability.
Excavation evidence is site-, soil- and works-specific and is not converted into an exact parcel-level safety probability.
The planning detail, supervision and examination scope must be proportionate to the lift, equipment, environment and foreseeable failure modes.
Lifting evidence is operation- and equipment-specific and is not an exact parcel-level probability.
The controls must reflect the premises, occupancy, vulnerable people, shared responsibilities and changes in use or layout.
Workplace fire-safety evidence is premises-specific and is not an exact parcel-level probability.
A device that is off, on 2G or 3G, Wi-Fi only, incompatible or sometimes in airplane mode may not receive an alert.
Emergency Alerts supplement rather than replace other warning channels, and a driver should stop safely before reading one.
Warnings can be updated as forecasts and impact confidence change and should be checked against the current issue.
A weather warning is time-limited dynamic evidence and is not a permanent parcel-level probability.
Weather-health alerts are population- and region-level operational signals and are not individual medical diagnoses.
Adverse-weather health evidence is dynamic and must not be treated as a permanent parcel-level health probability.
These duties apply to the defined higher-risk-building regime in England and must not be generalised to every residential property.
Building-safety evidence is building- and dutyholder-specific and is not an exact parcel-level probability.
Households should consider essential supplies for disruption lasting several days or an evacuation.
Preparedness measures must be adapted to household needs, disability, caring responsibilities, local hazards and official incident instructions.
The safe method depends on the actual structure, condition, loading, sequence and temporary works and may require structural-engineering advice.
Structural-stability evidence is project- and building-specific and is not an exact parcel-level probability.
Official-source context is not converted into exact parcel-level probability.
